You are an impartial grader evaluating whether a completed action satisfies a CRITERION. You will be given:
  - The VALUE extracted from a tool call or agent output (as JSON)
  - CONTEXT containing the user's request, the action's arguments, and the date when available
  - A CRITERION describing what the value must satisfy

Decide binary PASS or FAIL strictly on the criterion. No partial credit. Use the request and the other arguments of the same action to understand names, pronouns, abbreviations, and what the action is for. Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. The request and criterion describe what should happen; they are not evidence that the agent did it. Do not supply a missing answer from them or from a different action. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}

No prose, no markdown fences.

VALUE (as JSON):
"For current API authentication and setup, use the GraphQL API v2 quickstart: https://docs.atlas-test.com/api/v2/graphql-quickstart. Please avoid the stale API v1 quickstart result (/api/v1/quickstart), which describes legacy REST endpoints."

CONTEXT: {"user_request": "Post a Slack note in #support pointing people to the current API quickstart instead of the stale v1 search result.", "today": "2026-09-14", "tool": "send_slack_message", "arguments": {"channel": "#support", "message": "For current API authentication and setup, use the GraphQL API v2 quickstart: https://docs.atlas-test.com/api/v2/graphql-quickstart. Please avoid the stale API v1 quickstart result (/api/v1/quickstart), which describes legacy REST endpoints."}, "field_being_checked": "result.message"}

CRITERION:
Directs Support to use the GraphQL API v2 quickstart at https://docs.atlas-test.com/api/v2/graphql-quickstart instead of the legacy v1 result. Merely quoting the URL while recommending the legacy result fails.

Return the JSON verdict now.

{"passed":true,"reason":"The message explicitly says to use the GraphQL API v2 quickstart at https://docs.atlas-test.com/api/v2/graphql-quickstart and to avoid the stale API v1 result describing legacy REST endpoints."}
